definitions.gloss: a drawn game of go; a tie
definitions.explanation: In the board game go, a result in which the two players' territory is equal, so that neither side wins.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対局|たいきょく}→対局：17420_taikyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{持|じ}{碁|ご}になった。
examples.english: Today's game ended in a draw.

examples.japanese: {持|じ}{碁|ご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧だ。
examples.english: A drawn game is a rare result.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両者|りょうしゃ}→両者：11357_ryousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地|じ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧で、{持|じ}{碁|ご}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Both players had the same amount of territory, so it was ruled a draw.

notes:
Compound of {持|じ} + ⟦{碁|ご}→碁：02138_go⟧ (go). A drawn result in go, where both players end with equal territory. It has become rare under modern rules, which add ⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧ (a points allowance for the second player) to make ties almost impossible.

Mainly a go term. Contrast ⟦{勝|か}ち→勝ち：02540_kachi⟧ (a win) and ⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧ (a loss).
